result_sentence: All 315 unit tests pass. In the first full browser run (parallel, on a slow laptop) 168 runs passed, 3 failed and 2 were flaky; every one of those passed when rerun one at a time on a clean state (99 of 99 runnable desktop tests in 17 of the 18 spec files, and the 18th, the link-crawl spec, passed in the first run). The link crawler followed 300 pages with no problems, all 39 access-control and security probes passed, and the production dependency audit reports 0 vulnerabilities.
findings_sentence: Testing found one real defect, now fixed with a regression test: the personal data export returned an error for every member. Four items remain open and are described with severity and evidence in the report: an intermittent reservation delay under parallel load, a slow first paint on two pages, an HTTP 200 status on denied pages (no data is exposed), and an admin tab bar clipped behind the search box.
